subject: Allocation of prepayment, VAT reversal, and refund / credit routing
body:
From: Soren Lind <soren@clearwave.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@clearwave.io
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Question on where our prepayment landed + VAT on Nov invoices

Hi Ben,

We ran our month-end and noticed a prepayment from ClearWave (wire 2026-11-27) doesn’t appear to have been applied across open invoices. Attached is our remittance CSV and copies of two invoices we expected to be covered (inv-0342 and inv-0457). Also, VAT was charged on inv-0457 even though we supplied our EU VAT ID earlier this year — can you confirm why that happened?

We’re trying to reconcile with our GL before closing the books. If this requires a credit note or refund, please advise next steps and timing.

Thanks,
Soren Lind
Director of Finance
ClearWave Analytics

---
Attachments: ClearWave_remit_20261127.csv, inv-20261001-0342.pdf, inv-20261101-0457.pdf

-----Original Message-----
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Soren Lind <soren@clearwave.io>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Question on where our prepayment landed + VAT on Nov invoices

Soren — thanks for the heads up and for sending the remit. I’ve looped in Grace (finance) and Marissa (account exec) to investigate allocation and the VAT flag.

Immediate asks:
- Grace: can you confirm whether the 11/27 wire was applied to invoice 0342 only, and whether inv-0457 shows VAT applied in our billing system?
- Marissa: please hold any collections outreach to ClearWave while finance verifies.

I’ll come back with an action plan, either to move the prepayment across invoices or to issue a credit/refund.

Ben Carter
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

On Mon, Nov 30, 2026 at 16:28, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com> wrote:

> From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
> To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
> Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
> Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:28:00 -0800
> Subject: RE: Question on where our prepayment landed + VAT on Nov invoices
> 
> Ben / Marissa — I pulled the ledger. Summary below: 
> 
> 1) Payment application: the 2026-11-27 incoming wire (bank ref RW-20261127-CW) was auto-applied by our payments engine to inv-0342 (open balance $8,700) leaving a residual of $1,950 that did not get allocated because inv-0457 was in a different tax bucket and our system prevented cross-bucket auto-application. The remit CSV you attached shows the intention to cover both invoices; that was not respected by our automated rules.
> 
> 2) VAT issue: inv-0457 (11/01/2026) was billed with a 20% VAT line. ClearWave’s EU VAT ID is on file, but the tax exemption flag failed to persist at time of invoice generation due to a recent schema change during rollout. That’s on us. The correct path is to issue a credit note for the VAT portion and reissue the invoice without VAT, or apply a VAT credit note that nets to zero.
> 
> Proposed remediation (two options):
> A) Apply remaining $1,950 of the prepayment to inv-0457, issue a VAT credit note for the VAT line on 0457, and reissue a corrected invoice without VAT. No cash movement required; totals net out.
> B) If ClearWave prefers cash, issue a refund for the gross VAT amount ($1,560) and apply the $1,950 to inv-0457. Refund requires confirmation of beneficiary bank details and will take 5–7 business days.
> 
> Accounting notes: we will need ClearWave’s VAT registration country confirmation for the credit note, and an internal journal to move the prepayment clearing account (GL 2103) to A/R on the applicable invoices and reverse the VAT liability (GL 2401). I’ve prepared a draft VAT adjustment workbook (attached).
> 
> I recommend option A unless the customer requests a cash refund. Marissa — can your renewal/CS outreach confirm preference?
> 
> Action items for Redwood (planned timeline):
> - Today (11/30): Grace to prepare credit note and corrected invoice drafts for review (ETA EOD 12/01).
> - 12/02: Apply prepayment allocation and post internal journal entries.
> - 12/03–12/06: If refund requested, Treasury to execute wire.
> 
> CC: Vivek for potential goodwill credit or SLA note if we need to offer concession.
> 
> Grace O'Connor
> Director, Revenue Operations
> Redwood Inference
> grace_oconnor@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0147
> 
> Attachments: VAT-reversal-request.xlsx
> 
> -----Original Message-----
> From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
> To: Soren Lind <soren@clearwave.io>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
> Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
> Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
> Subject: Re: Question on where our prepayment landed + VAT on Nov invoices
> 
> Hi Soren — sorry for the churn here. We absolutely don’t want this to impact your close. Two quick notes: 
> 
> - If Grace’s option A looks good to you, we’ll apply the prepayment and issue a VAT credit note; no further action on your side.
> - As a gesture for the inconvenience caused by the tax flag bug, I’ve proposed a one-month service credit to offer the equivalent of $2,000 applied in Jan invoice, subject to legal approval. Vivek, can you sign off on a goodwill credit memo if needed?
> 
> Please confirm option A or B and whether you want the refund to go to the same bank account on file.
> 
> Best,
> Marissa Cole
> Account Executive, Redwood Inference
> marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0129
> 
> On Thu, Dec 2, 2026 at 15:42, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com> wrote:

> > Subject: Next steps — prepayment allocation + VAT credit note
> > 
> > Hi Soren — quick update and next steps: 
> > 
> > 1) We will proceed with option A as Grace recommended: apply the $1,950 residual prepayment to invoice inv-0457 and issue a VAT credit note to reverse the VAT on inv-0457. Corrected invoice and credit note drafts are attached for review.
> > 2) If you prefer a cash refund of the VAT instead, reply and confirm the beneficiary bank details; otherwise we will not issue a refund and will simply credit the account.
> > 3) Accounting will post the internal journals on 2026-12-02 and finalize the credit note by EOD 2026-12-03. Expect the corrected invoice to show net lines and a credit note reference.
> > 4) Regarding the goodwill credit: we will not automatically apply it yet. Marissa will follow up with you to confirm whether you want the one-month credit applied to Jan 2027 invoice; Vivek, please confirm approval for a $2,000 service credit if required.
> > 
> > Soren — can you please confirm: (a) country for VAT registration (for the credit note), and (b) whether you want a refund instead of invoice-level credit? If we don’t hear back by EOD 12/03 we will proceed with the credit note path.
> > 
> > Thanks for your patience — sorry again for the rollout bug.
